visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views, including a curated 1024×640 preview. Individual cream-white mosque with one larger pale pointed dome, smaller western cap, paired stepped minarets with square bases/octagonal shafts, two projecting balcony tiers and pale pointed caps. Pointed entrance/window recesses and original coarse open diamond parapets define the exterior rhythm. Corrected an octagonal trim band that was displaced by multiplying world coordinates, added a campus-envelope check, and retained a single main pointed entrance. No displaced trim remains in the final views. Internal roof/wing division, centers, bay rhythm and all heights are estimates. Fine historical interlacing, inscriptions, fixtures, palms, landscaping, newer surrounding decks/parking/shade sails and furnished interiors are omitted.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi Masjid al-Qiblatain exterior: exact irregular main footprint, pale main dome and smaller western side dome, paired stepped square/octagonal minarets with projecting balconies and pointed caps, light roof cornices, open original diamond parapets and recessed pointed entrance/window rhythms. Main dome drum 11.2–13 m, pale pointed cap to 21.4 m and finial 23 m; side dome base 8.2 m, cap to 12.2 m and finial 13.5 m. Twin minarets have square bases to 12 m, tapered octagonal shafts to 25 m, projecting balcony around 25–26.3 m, upper tiers to 34 m, smaller balcony and pale pointed cap/finial to 42 m. Every vertical dimension, window rhythm, parapet module, tier, balcony and dome profile is approximate. No engineering or furnished interior claim. Detailed facade facing and all dome/tower positions, internal dimensions, heights, parapet modules and bay rhythms remain estimates; orientation uncertainty is recorded as 30 degrees. The 2025 picture includes newer foreground construction which is not established as part of this exact mapped building. Those surrounding decks, shade structures, city and unseen interiors remain outside this model.
